check.cmd:
python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('data.json'))
gs = d['generations']
assert all(len(g['badges']) == 4 for g in gs), [len(g['badges']) for g in gs]
replay = [g['index'] for g in gs if any('防重放 ✗' in b for b in g['badges'])]
safe = [g['index'] for g in gs if any('抗主动探测 ✅' in b for b in g['badges'])]
assert replay == [1], replay
assert safe == [5, 6], safe
print('4x%d | replay-missing@%s | probe-safe@%s' % (len(gs), replay, safe))
"

check.cmd:
python3 -c "
import pathlib, re
t = pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/claims.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'alloevil/verify-claims@v0.1.0' in t, 'action 的版本钉子不见了'
assert re.search(r'cron:.{0,3}17 6 \* \* 1', t), '每周兜底的 cron 不见了'
assert re.search(r'^  push:', t, re.M), 'push 触发不见了'
assert re.search(r'^  pull_request:', t, re.M), 'PR 触发不见了'
print('weekly 17 6 * * 1 | pin alloevil/verify-claims@v0.1.0 | push+PR')
"
